answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable 50 POA fee, burned at registration, so bulk forgery is sunk cost. After 20 honest epochs the tax halves, rewarding one long-lived identity. A garden stays healthy; each trellis is built once, not cloned: forging 1,000 identities burns 50,000 POA against 200 POA per honest identity per epoch, so the attacker loses first. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards, and the network stays a haven.
